# ClipStack
> Minimal macOS clipboard history manager with direct Apple Silicon and Intel downloads.

## Main pages
- [Download homepage](https://clipstack.click/): Direct download links, release status, features, and FAQ.
- [Imprint](https://clipstack.click/imprint.html): Legal and contact information.

## Key facts
- Platform: macOS 14+
- Tech stack: Rust + Tauri + Svelte
- Privacy: local storage, no telemetry by default
- Source repository: https://github.com/Glossardi/ClipStack
- Releases: https://github.com/Glossardi/ClipStack/releases/latest
